rootCause: R07-R09 hand-promoted entry.v2.json products independently of their evidence.draft.json worksheets and stored only hit-line anchors, leaving stale regeneration inputs and incomplete line ranges.

invariants: A reviewed semantic entry and dossier are serialized into one pipeline-v2 worksheet.
Complete-context FromLb/ToLb coordinates are generated from unique zc.verify results.
The worksheet compiles once into the canonical product.
A second compile must preserve byte-identical canonical bytes.
Tier-3 selection is rejected when stronger unselected candidates remain without exceptional justification.
SourceTexts and RelatedMasters are mechanically derived from retained occurrences.
